unit.why: A short narrative about R. Shmuel's discipleship: he was a pupil of R. Mordechai of Kshanov, moved to the Berditchever, then left him for the Seer of Lublin, who had him cook his dish daily.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי שהרה״ק הנ״ל היה תלמיד של
stories.end_quote: שבישל לו והרבי שמח עמו מאוד
stories.summary_en: After the death of his master R. Mordechai, R. Shmuel went to R. Levi Yitzhak of Berditchev. The Berditchever rejoiced in him and took him to every wedding and circumcision. R. Shmuel then told him 'you are not my rebbe' and went to the Seer of Lublin, who rejoiced in him and had him cook his dish every day.

tags.why: The story concerns a disciple seeking his true master.

quotes: ואחר פטירת הרה״ק מסכיאש נסע לההר״ק ב״ה קדושת לוי
tags.why: He goes to other tzaddikim after his master's death.

quotes: ונסע להרבי זצ״ל מלובלין וכשבא אצלו
tags.why: He journeys to a tzaddik's court.

quotes: כשהי׳ הולך על חתונה או על ברית
tags.why: Circumcisions are mentioned only as occasions he attended.

quotes: ושמח עמו מאוד כמו מי שמוצא שלל רב
tags.why: Both tzaddikim's joy in him is repeated throughout.
The tzaddikim receive and welcome the newcomer.

quotes: אתם אינכם רבי שלי ונפטר ממנו לשלום
tags.why: He seeks the tzaddik who is truly his own rebbe.
His master's death is mentioned only in passing.

missing_concepts: Disciple serving the tzaddik by cooking his food (personal service, shimush)
